title: feedback
description: Topic {prefix}/{robot_id}/task/{task_id}/feedback, ROS to HA, QoS 0, not retained, message expiry 10 s. Optional progress report for a running task, throttled on the node to reply.feedback_max_rate_hz (default 2).

progress.description: Fraction complete from 0 to 1, or null when the executor cannot estimate it.

stage.description: Short machine-friendly stage name, may be empty.

message.description: Human-readable progress text, may be empty.
